name: PHANTOM RIDER
tagline: Theremin wails, ghost choirs, twang guitar, haunted organs and wraith pads: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Theremin, ghost choir, twang, organs and pads
gumroad_title: PHANTOM RIDER - Ghost Western Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Dark Trap, Cinematic, Western, Horror
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (Theremin, Ghost Choir, Twang Guitar, Haunted Organ, Wraith Pad, Ghost Bells, Dead Bass and Whisper Wind) and 70 factory presets.
about: PHANTOM RIDER, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines (Theremin, Ghost Choir, Twang Guitar, Haunted Organ, Wraith Pad, Ghost Bells, Dead Bass and Whisper Wind), shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb. The character is spectral and lonesome, a ghost-town western mood.
51 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode and 19 in Mono mode, so you can play chords or single-note lines from the first preset.
Built for dark Trap and Drill toplines, cinematic and horror scoring, spaghetti-western moods and atmospheric intros.

features.d: Theremin with a vibrato that settles in, vowel ghost choir, plucked twang guitar, haunted organ, wraith pad, ghost bells, dead bass and whispering wind.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from theremin whistles and ghost choirs to twang guitars, haunted organs, wraith pads and dead bass.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated attack, decay and release envelope.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 36 to 84), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: PHANTOM RIDER plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.
No. Every sound is generated in real time by one of eight synthesis engines.

faq.q: Can I play chords with the theremin presets?
faq.a: The theremin presets load in Mono with glide. Switch VOICE MODE to Poly for chords (up to 16 voices).

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .prpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
